content.text: Only one subset matches, and each of the five named students has exactly one invoice.

input.rationale: Lender disbursal lists five students. Each has one open invoice (Rohan Nair INV-00254, Ishaan Pillai INV-00255, Krishna Malhotra INV-00256, Meera Das INV-00257, Kavya Malhotra INV-00258). The subset-sum tool shows these five sum exactly to 20,400,000 paise and are the only such subset among the candidates. Other same-surname invoices (Neel and Rohan Malhotra) belong to students not named.
